text:
Aiden: hey folks, first day here. i'm on a company linux laptop (Ubuntu 22.04) and hitting an Okta device-enrollment block. Okta only shows "Register security key" and i don't have a YubiKey yet. 1Password invite hasn't arrived either. who should i ping?

Sophie (IT): welcome Aiden! :wave: for Linux we often use an SSH-attestation flow if you don't have a hardware token yet. are you on corp VPN? also check spam.

it-ops-bot: Ticket ONB-6201 created for linux-enroll-ssh:2765432100. Assigned to Sophie (IT). ETA 2h.

Aiden: i'm at home on my router, not VPN. 1P not in spam. Okta keeps blocking saying "device enrollment required" and only offering security key registration.

Sophie (IT): ok — quick plan: 1) generate an ed25519 keypair and paste the public key here, 2) i'll ingest the public key into our device registry and issue a temporary device certificate, 3) i'll also re-send the 1Password invite. run: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "aiden@redwood.dev" -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 -N ""`

Aiden: ran it and here's the public key: `ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAID...aiden@redwood.dev`

Sophie (IT): received. adding to device registry and issuing a short-lived device cert for your account now. re-sent 1Password invite as well.

1Password-bot: 1Password invite resent to aiden@redwood.dev (item: Redwood - New Hire Seat).

Sophie (IT): try Okta in an incognito/private window and select the option to use a device certificate. I bound the cert to your SSH key attestation.

Aiden: tried incognito 5 Okta accepted the device cert and allowed me to continue. during MFA it prompted for a security key and i couldn't find a fallback; it tried to SMS me but i haven't set that.

Evan (Security): we recently tightened MFA to prefer hardware security keys, but we allow a temporary TOTP fallback for new hires for 48 hours. Sophie, can you enable the exception for aiden@redwood.dev?

Sophie (IT): done. temporary Okta exception enabled to allow Okta Verify/TOTP for 48h. Aiden, choose "Set up another factor" -> Okta Verify and follow the steps.

Aiden: set up Okta Verify, approved sign-in. 1Password invite arrived and i accepted it, can see the company vault now. access looks good.

Rachelle (People Ops): welcome Aiden! i've emailed YubiKey tracking (ships in 3 business days). added you to the afternoon onboarding standup.

Sophie (IT): closing ONB-6201: resolved with SSH key attestation + temporary MFA exception + 1Password reissue. Note for docs: linux onboarding uses SSH attestation when hardware tokens not yet delivered.

Aiden: thanks everyone, big help! excited to get started :rocket:
